A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TVVE research and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E. Added, moved, and renumbered material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v4 reports original RLBench, RLBench-OG, and real-robot experiments, including ablations, robustness tests, and routing analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results and adds RVT2 comparisons for single-view RLBench and RLBench-OG.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain the same TaskMoE routing, MVEP camera-pose prediction, pseudo-environment interaction, losses, and three-stage training procedure. The revised abstract describes the existing method more explicitly.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same RLBench tasks, ten-task RLBench-OG perturbation suite, and Dobot and Franka scenarios, including appendix experiments. Adding RVT2 results does not expand task or environmental coverage.

E2.justification: RVT2, already present in the multi-view comparison, is added to single-view RLBench in Table 2 and RLBench-OG in Table 3 and appendix Table 14. Other comparator membership is retained.

E3.justification: The stated camera configurations, training and evaluation sample counts, metrics, and perturbation procedures remain unchanged. The added RVT2 comparisons use existing setups without a reported protocol revision.

E4.justification: The robustness comparison adds RVT2 evidence across the existing two occlusion conditions and six environmental perturbations. Component ablations, routing analyses, efficiency studies, unseen-task tests, and real-world robustness analyses are otherwise unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions specify mean and standard deviation over three independent RLBench-OG trials. The added RVT2 results follow existing uncertainty-reporting practices; no changed run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests are reported.

E6.justification: v5 adds RVT2 success rates of 82.7±0.7% for single-view RLBench and 64.5±8.3% for RLBench-OG, plus detailed perturbation results. Existing success rates remain unchanged. With the expanded comparator sets, TVVE's reported average ranks change from 1.6 to 2.15 and from 1.1 to 1.4, respectively; these are not success-rate declines.

T1.justification: Equations 1–20 and Algorithm 1 retain the same mathematical definitions and procedures, including camera parameterization, reward construction, and TaskMoE regularization. No substantive derivation, assumption, or proof changes appear.

C1.justification: The contributions remain MVEP, TaskMoE, RLBench-OG, and improved manipulation performance and robustness. The abstract uses more restrained wording, but the introduction and conclusion retain the same substantive contribution claims and scope.

C2.justification: The explanations connecting viewpoint selection and expert specialization to performance remain unchanged. Both versions retain limitations concerning rendering latency and dependence on accurate point clouds, including difficulties with reflective or transparent objects.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, Table 10 hyperparameters, hardware descriptions, appendix construction instructions, and the TAVP access link are unchanged. The additional RVT2 scores are not accompanied by new implementation or training details.

R1.justification: Both versions retain the same 57 references and substantive related-work positioning. Publication-venue labels added beside baseline names are bibliographic presentation changes.

P1.justification: The abstract is rewritten to explain virtual-view selection, re-rendering, and expert routing more directly. Other edits include limited wording changes, updated affiliation and publication information, and acknowledgments; the main section and appendix organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Tables 2 and 3 gain RVT2 rows, and v5 adds appendix Table 14. Earlier Tables 14–16 become Tables 15–17, with some relocation. Venue labels and table formatting also change, while existing figure content is retained.

improvement.justification: The added RVT2 comparisons make the empirical evidence more complete and expose the narrow single-view margin of 83.2% versus 82.7%; the revised abstract also improves clarity. These benefits outweigh a limited consistency regression: Section 4.2 still quotes obsolete Table 3 ranks, including 1.1 for TVVE instead of 1.4, and the single-view caption retains its unqualified 'substantial improvement' wording.
